candidate_reports.remark: Large tree down_ blocking Victory Blvd. Time estimated by radar.
2 ft of water at Planet Fitness and multiple businesses reported in Woodland Park in the vicinity of Andrews Drive.
Fire department is responding to multiple vehicles trapped in flood waters in the city of Paterson. High water vehicle is also being used.
Vehicle stranded in flood waters on 21st Avenue near Martin Street.
Road closed due to flooding at Midland Avenue and Cottage Street.
Rye Police Department reports numerous roadways closed due to flooding. Some of these include - Playland Parkway_ Midland Ave @ Peck Ave_ and Milton Road by the Marina.
Road closed due to flooding along North Regan Street near Glen Avenue.
Cars avoiding 2 to 3 ft of standing water on I 95 at Laddins Rock Road and going on edge of shoulder to pass with water more than half way up tires.
Stamford FD reports multiple vehicles with flood water up their windows on Hamilton Ave.
Stamford FD reports active water rescue at intersection of Cherry and Jefferson.
Stamford FD reports multiple water rescues in progress at intersection of Grove and Broad St.
